name: Mobile Menu
summary: Direct-link site navigation list composed inside canonical Drawer without duplicating overlay state or menu-widget semantics.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native navigation list rendered inside a labelled navigation region and canonical Drawer body.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One or more native list items.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Native destination link with touch-safe sizing, containment, and optional aria-current.

states.name: separatedItems
states.description: Adjacent rows use a semantic subtle divider.

states.name: currentPage
states.description: Current destination retains primary text contrast with an accent underline.

states.name: linkHover
states.description: Fine-pointer hover adds a secondary surface without changing link meaning.

states.name: linkFocusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus remains visible within the Drawer body.

behavior.name: drawerComposition
behavior.description: Mobile Menu supplies navigation content only and inherits the canonical Drawer's title, dismiss action, open state, focus containment, Escape handling, inertness, and focus restoration.

behavior.name: siteNavigation
behavior.description: Use direct native links for site destinations; do not apply menu, menuitem, menubar, or roving-focus semantics.

behavior.name: targetNavigationOwnership
behavior.description: The target owns route resolution and whether successful navigation closes its containing Drawer.

behavior.name: directLevelBoundary
behavior.description: The v1 contract certifies one direct link level; nested disclosure navigation remains an unresolved target/product decision.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more target-owned direct destinations, labels, order, and current-page markup.

accessibility: Render the native list inside a labelled nav region and canonical modal Drawer.
Use native destination links rather than ARIA menu roles or application-style arrow-key interaction.
Expose the current destination with aria-current="page" when applicable.
Preserve Drawer focus containment, Escape dismissal, focus restoration, and background inertness.
Keep localized labels wrap-safe, touch-sized, keyboard visible, reduced-motion safe, and forced-colors legible.

web.notes: Canonical direct-link list presentation and states are implemented; overlay lifecycle is inherited from Drawer and demonstrated by the shared docs renderer.

shopify.notes: Current Liquid maps first-level Shopify navigation, while the missing Drawer lifecycle and any nested-menu policy remain target work.
